title: Thai-Style Grilled Melon
description: A refreshing and easy-to-make dessert featuring grilled melon, perfect for warm weather. This dish is a beautiful combination of sweet and savory, making it a great ending to a meal.

ingredients.name: melon
ingredients.notes: any type of melon, such as cantaloupe or honeydew

instructions: Cut the melon into slices, about 1 inch thick.
In a small bowl, mix together the roast and a pinch of salt.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the melon slices for 2-3 minutes per side, or until they have nice grill marks.
Sprinkle the roast mixture over the grilled melon slices.
